meta.name: Dummy test template
meta.description: Template minimale per testare motore, condizioni e frontiera. Un check di rete, una question di macchina che sblocca un check.

chk_live_hosts.command:
# ICMP sweep
nmap -sn 10.10.10.0/24

# TCP scan top 100 ports
nmap -sS --top-ports 100 10.10.10.0/24

# UDP scan top 10 ports
nmap -sU --top-ports 10 10.10.10.0/24
chk_live_hosts.notes: Run all three to catch hosts that block ICMP. UDP is slow, top 10 is enough for a first pass.

chk_enum_ports.command:
# Full TCP SYN scan
nmap -sS -p- -T4 10.10.10.5

# Service and version detection on found ports
nmap -sCV -p <ports> 10.10.10.5
chk_enum_ports.notes: Full port sweep first, then targeted service detection on whatever is open.
